name: miadi-deepdiver
description: DeepDiver for the Miadi Factory's production team (T6): feed Miadi reviews and their screenwalk videos into a Gemini Notebook, ask it the episode's questions, generate and keep its media (infographics, video and audio overviews, interactive reports), and put that media on screen in the next screenwalk. Give /deepdive an episode, a review, or both and it runs the whole pass, from a Chrome signed in once to the media landed in the episode. Carries the screenwalk-notebook skill, which performs the NotebookFed and MediaMade transitions of the screenwalk media cycle, and /notebook-from-reviews.
